# Cord

> Last reviewed: 2026-08-28
>
> Cord is a commercial-closing platform built by Flouvia. It connects an
> interactive quote, client approval, payment, invoicing, and collections in one
> workflow. Cord is a standalone product at cordhq.app; it is not a CRM, ERP,
> payment processor, tax authority, or notarial service.

## Availability

Cord currently offers signup in 12 markets:

- Mexico (MX)
- United States (US)
- Canada (CA)
- Brazil (BR)
- Spain (ES)
- United Kingdom (GB)
- Germany (DE)
- France (FR)
- Colombia (CO)
- Argentina (AR)
- Chile (CL)
- Peru (PE)

Online payments through Cord Payments are currently available for businesses in
MX, US, CA, BR, ES, GB, DE, and FR. Businesses in CO, AR, CL, and PE can quote,
invoice, track collections, and record payments received outside Cord, but cannot
activate online payments inside the Cord link yet. SPEI is available only for
eligible Mexican accounts and MXN transactions.

Cord offers these transaction currencies: MXN, USD, CAD, BRL, EUR, GBP, COP,
ARS, CLP, PEN, JPY, CNY, CHF, and AUD. Availability of an online payment also
depends on the business country, currency, provider, and account eligibility.

## Core capabilities

- Create quotes manually or generate a draft from text, PDF, or images with Cord AI.
- Configure products, services, negotiated pricing, volume tiers, costs, margins,
  advance payments, recurring retainers, and Net credit terms.
- Send an interactive client link with general and line-item comments, partial
  approval, declared signer identity, timestamp, IP address, and a fingerprint of
  the approved version.
- Collect eligible online payments through Stripe Connect, or record external
  payments where Cord Payments is unavailable.
- Create invoices, recurring invoices, reminders, balances, and collections flows.
- Run an opt-in AI collections agent in approval or automatic mode, within rules
  configured by the business.
- Quote in one currency and keep books in another using a dated FX rate. FX Lock
  preserves the accepted rate for the configured quote window; it is not a
  financial derivative or a guarantee from a bank.
- Use a public REST API, signed webhooks, an MCP server, and Cord Elements.

## Fiscal boundaries

- Mexico: Cord can issue real CFDI 4.0 through Facturapi when the organization has
  valid fiscal data and a valid CSD. XML and PDF are tied to the stamped document.
- Spain: Cord can issue a commercial invoice. A chained Verifactu record is created
  only when the organization has a valid electronic certificate and Cord's
  software-system identity and regulatory rail are enabled. Otherwise the status
  is `commercial_only`. Submission to the Spanish tax authority is a separate,
  asynchronous status.
- Other supported markets: Cord issues a commercial invoice and does not
  automatically file it with the local tax authority. The business must confirm
  local reporting and tax obligations with its adviser.

Cord stores technical evidence of an approval. It does not provide legal advice,
notarial certification, or a guarantee that evidence will win a dispute or have
the same legal effect in every jurisdiction.

## Documentation

## Plans and free allowance

Free has no expiry date and requires no credit card. It includes 5 quote sends
per calendar month (renewed on the first day, UTC) and up to 5 active quotes at
once. Closing a quote frees an active slot, not a monthly send. Free includes
the business's logo and colors alongside “Powered by Cord”. Removing that
branding starts at Starter; Professional adds unlimited quotes, 5 included
users and collections. Scale supports email from the business's domain;
custom domains for hosted quote links are not currently available.
Online payment processing fees are separate. See [current pricing](https://cordhq.app/pricing.md)
for prices, currencies and included usage.
